title: Unit table row
description: One row of a unit table (TSV): a region of a protein that something is counted in or drawn as. Positions are 1-based and inclusive, on the snapshot's sequences. Columns after the six below are the unit's own.

unit_id.description: accession:kind:start-end, unless the source gives its own stable id

kind.description: site, disordered, idr, domain, flank, segment, ...

source.description: where the units come from, with its version
